name: Doxy.me
short_description: Free HIPAA-compliant telemedicine platform used by 1.5M+ providers with browser-based video visits, virtual waiting room, and no downloads required for patients.
long_description: Doxy.me is a HIPAA-compliant telemedicine platform designed to help healthcare providers conduct secure video consultations with patients using any web browser. Trusted by over 1.5 million care providers who have delivered over 14 billion minutes of care, Doxy.me offers a permanent free tier that includes all essential compliance features including a Business Associate Agreement (BAA). The platform requires no downloads or installations for patients - they simply click a personalized link to join their provider's virtual waiting room. Paid plans (Professional at $35/month, Clinic at $50/user/month) add features like HD video, screen sharing, group calls up to 10 participants, file sharing, patient payments, and custom branding. Named the Easiest to Use Winner on G2 in 2025, Doxy.me is SOC 2 Type 2 and SOC 3 certified.

faqs.q: Is Doxy.me really free and HIPAA compliant?
faqs.a: Yes, Doxy.me offers a permanent free tier that is fully HIPAA compliant and includes a Business Associate Agreement (BAA). The free version includes video visits, virtual waiting room, and chat.

faqs.q: Do patients need to download anything for Doxy.me?
faqs.a: No, Doxy.me is browser-based and works on any device without downloads or installations. Patients simply click a personalized link to join their provider's virtual waiting room.

faqs.q: How much does Doxy.me cost for paid plans?
faqs.a: Professional plans start at $29/month (annual billing) or $35/month for independent practitioners. Clinic plans for teams cost $50/user/month. Enterprise pricing is custom.

faqs.q: What features require a paid Doxy.me plan?
faqs.a: Paid plans unlock HD video, screen sharing, group calls up to 10 participants, file sharing, patient payment collection, and custom branding. The free version has standard video quality and limited features.
